name: TechBehemoths

sources.title: FAQ (search-indexed) — 'Get Listed' → type company name → claim existing or register; corporate email required (Gmail/Yahoo rejected); platform is 100% free
Terms & Conditions (search-indexed) — listings can be removed at sole discretion; submissions become their property

conditions: Listing is free, but it is a directory of IT service companies/agencies — a SaaS product fits only if registered as its company (e.g. software development company profile), not as a product listing
Claiming a profile requires a corporate email on the company domain — Gmail/Yahoo/etc. are rejected
requirements: An IT services/software company (the directory matches clients with IT service providers, not standalone products)
Company name check first — many companies are pre-listed and must be claimed rather than re-registered
Corporate email address on the company domain for verification
Complete profile drives ranking: portfolio, reviews, contacts, descriptions
preparation: Check whether the company is already listed on TechBehemoths (they pre-populate profiles)
Corporate email access for the confirmation email
Company profile material: services, portfolio items, location, contacts, descriptions
workflow: Click 'Get Listed' (top right) on techbehemoths.com — use a browser, the site 403s automated fetches
Type the company name; if a managed profile exists, click 'Claim Now'; otherwise register new
Enter a corporate email and confirm via the automated email
Complete the profile (portfolio, services, reviews, contacts) — detail level affects search ranking
Profile goes live and can receive client inquiries
watchFor: Product-only SaaS has no product-listing surface; the entity listed is the company
Terms allow removal of listings at sole discretion and claim ownership of submitted content
Third-party backlink services describe it as a dofollow listing — verify link treatment on the live page
countsAsLive: A claimed/registered company profile is publicly viewable in TechBehemoths search results with services, location and website link
unknowns: Whether listing links are dofollow (third-party claims, not verified)
Whether non-agency SaaS companies are accepted
